title: Certificate of fitness.
officialText:
Where fuel-oil piping systems utilize pumps to transfer fuel oil to equipment at levels above the lowest
floor or to storage tanks at levels above the lowest floor in buildings, a qualified employee or contracted general company holding a
certificate of fitness from the Fire Department shall maintain the fuel-oil system.
SECTION MC 1302
MATERIAL
